title: Pin the applied-begin budget exemption for a head with an active grant but no retained evaluate
outcome: engram_head_begin_applied (src/engram_begin_preparation_retry.rs about :250) exempts a head from the admission budget only when the active grant equals the front prompt's retained engram_evaluate.begun_grant_id. That fixed round 1's Medium, where any active grant exempted a successor. A head with an active grant but no retained evaluate (for example after a Defer clears engram_evaluate, or a promoted head) would have its budget enforced although Engram applied its begin, and the tick could then hold an already-begun head at the deadline. No reachable sequence has been shown: a begun head's turn normally runs (session Active), which the tick skips. Either a test pins that such a head is never held, or the exemption falls back safely when the front has no evaluate, without re-opening round 1's Medium.
acceptance: A test establishes whether a head with an active grant and no retained evaluate can reach the admission-budget hold. If it can, it is exempted without letting another turn's open grant exempt a successor's window; if it cannot, the test pins that.
